articles.summary: It’s 2022 and Australia still doesn’t have true usage-based personal motor insurance, at least from what I could find when looking to insure my own vehicle. I live in the inner city, drive infrequently, and believe I’m a good driver, so I’d benefit from a telematics-based insurance product. While there are many “pay-as-you-drive” products, very few look at your actual driving, instead relying on manually updated odometer readings to make premium adjustments.
articles.title: What Makes Usage-Based Insurance Possible?
